model_preprocessing.calendar_series_use: display only; forward-filled dates are excluded from model training
model_preprocessing.forecast_horizons: calendar days; the first official posting on or after the target date supplies the outcome

7d.selection_method: Highest mean rolling-origin balanced accuracy, then macro F1 and accuracy; final holdout excluded from model selection.
7d.purge_rule: remove training rows whose future outcome date reaches the test period
7d.evaluation_note: Balanced accuracy is unavailable because the chronological test window contains one class.

backtest.scope: first 80% of observations; final 20% reserved as holdout
